description: [Chinese version] Updated 2024-05-20. Based on Prometheus kafka_exporter, comprehensive Kafka resource dashboard! Includes overall Kafka resource status, producer-consumer relationships, detailed message backlog information, production and consumption rates, and per-partition backlog and consumption details. https://grafana.com/orgs/starsliao/dashboards

panels.description: Includes topics with no consumer groups consuming them
panels.title: Topics

panels.description:
- When both menu filters are set to All Consumer Groups and All Topics, this table shows the list of consumer groups associated with topics.
- When a consumer group is selected in the menu, the right-side table will show topics consumed by that group; the current table shows consumer groups that consume the topics listed on the right.
panels.title: Consumer Groups (linked to right Topics table)

panels.description:
- When both menu filters are set to All Consumer Groups and All Topics, this table shows the list of topics associated with consumer groups.
- When a topic is selected in the menu, the left-side table will show the list of consumers that consume that topic.
panels.title: Topics (linked to left Consumer Groups table)
